about.title: About AIHOT
about.subtitle: A real-time index of global AI news.
about.whatText: AIHOT (AI Hot Takes) is a rolling timeline of global artificial-intelligence news, automatically aggregated from official product blogs, English and Chinese media, and community discussions. Every item in the timeline is a link to its original source — AIHOT is an index and aggregator, not a publisher of the underlying stories.
about.dataText: About twenty source feeds are crawled every thirty minutes. Each incoming item is deduplicated, categorized into one of three buckets — Official (product blogs and release notes), Media (English and Chinese press), or Community (forums and social posts) — and assigned a locale-aware headline and summary. Cross-source items that point to the same underlying event are grouped into an Event page, which adds a machine-written synthesis, a chronological source progression, and a forward-looking signal describing what to watch next.
about.scoringText: Every item carries an AIHOT importance score rendered as a colored tier badge. The score is a blended signal of recency, source weight, and how many independent sources are reporting the same event within a rolling window. The three visible tiers are: Major (score ≥ 80, shown in red), Important (score 65–79, shown in orange), and Normal (below 65, shown in muted gray). The score is a ranking aid, not a claim about factual accuracy or newsworthiness.
about.privacyText: AIHOT requires no account, stores no personal data, and sets only a small theme-persistence cookie in your browser. The public site is served from Cloudflare Pages; data is stored on Turso (libSQL). News content copyright belongs to the original sources — clicking any card's verify link takes you to that source's original article.
about.langText: The timeline, daily briefings, event pages, and entity views are available in five languages: English, 中文 (Chinese), 日本語 (Japanese), Español (Spanish), and Français (French). Headlines and summaries are localized per locale; original-source timestamps are preserved and rendered in your browser's local timezone.
about.teamText: AIHOT is maintained by the Cataito team. Cataito also publishes cataito.com, an international AI-tool directory and ranking. If you spot incorrect categorization, broken links, or want to request a source, reach us at hello@cataito.com or open an issue on the public GitHub repository.
